name: Sync Service Health Check
description: Verify the tachin-website sync-service pipeline is healthy. Checks Cloud Run status, Drive watch expiration, GCS bucket freshness, and end-to-end connectivity.

gcp_project.description: GCP project ID for the sync service

gcs_bucket.description: GCS bucket name for synced assets

sync_service_url.description: URL of the sync-service Cloud Run instance

steps.title: Check sync-service Cloud Run status
steps.description:
Verify the sync-service Cloud Run instance is running and healthy.

Run this command:
```bash
gcloud run services describe sync-service --project=${gcp_project} --region=${region} --format='value(status.conditions[0].status)'
```

Also check recent logs for errors:
```bash
gcloud run services logs read sync-service --project=${gcp_project} --region=${region} --limit=10 2>&1 | tail -15
```

Output: the service status (True/False) and any errors from recent logs.
steps.accept_criteria: The sync-service Cloud Run status is reported. Recent logs are checked for errors.

steps.title: Verify Drive watch is active
steps.description:
Check if the Drive API watch channel is still active by examining the sync-service logs for the most recent watch registration.

Run this command to check watch registration logs:
```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="sync-service" AND textPayload:"watch"' --project=${gcp_project} --freshness=24h --limit=10 --format='value(textPayload)'
```

Look for:
- `Auto-registering Drive watch on startup...` — watch was registered
- `Using webhook address: https://sync-service-....run.app/sync-all` — correct notification address
- `Watch registration returned 200` — registration succeeded

⚠️ The webhook address MUST be the sync-service's own Cloud Run URL + /sync-all, NOT a Pub/Sub topic URL.

The watch channel expires every ~24 hours. If no registration in the last 24h, the watch may be expired.

Output: whether the watch is active or expired, the webhook address, and the last registration timestamp.
steps.accept_criteria: The Drive watch status is determined — either active (recent registration found with correct webhook address) or expired (no registration in logs within 24h).

steps.title: Renew watch if expired
steps.description:
If the Drive watch was found to be expired or no recent renewal was found, renew it.

Run this command:
```bash
curl -X POST ${sync_service_url}/renew-watch 2>&1
```

If the watch was still active, report that no renewal was needed.

Output: the renewal response or confirmation that no renewal was needed.
steps.accept_criteria: Either the watch was renewed (response shows success) or it was confirmed still active and no renewal was needed.

steps.title: Check GCS bucket freshness
steps.description:
Verify the GCS bucket has files and check the most recently modified file.

Run these commands:
```bash
gsutil ls gs://${gcs_bucket}/public/ | wc -l
gsutil ls -l gs://${gcs_bucket}/public/ | sort -k2 | tail -5
```

Output: total file count and the 5 most recently modified files.
steps.accept_criteria: The GCS bucket file count is reported. The most recently modified files are listed with timestamps.

steps.title: Report health status
steps.description:
Compile a health report summarizing all checks.

The report should include:
- Sync-service Cloud Run status (healthy/unhealthy)
- Drive watch status (active/expired/renewed)
- GCS bucket file count and freshness
- Overall verdict: HEALTHY, DEGRADED, or FAILED

Output: the structured health report.
steps.accept_criteria: A structured health report is produced with an overall HEALTHY/DEGRADED/FAILED verdict.
